_comment: Copy to config.json (or point to another path with the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file contains only two settings, database and skill_dir; other settings such as the LLM go through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > the database section of this file. Use one of two styles: (A) fill in the separate fields below; (B) fill in only database.dsn with a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): remove the database section above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the separate fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one subdirectory per skill, each containing SKILL.md). Precedence: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. A relative path is resolved against the current working directory.
